name: We're Nudists
source:
This game puts you in the shoes of an absolutely incredible main character with the finest sculpted body and muscle lines. I just know that every woman out there will fall head over heels at the sight of him!
He was lucky enough to get divorced from a suffocating woman that made his life a living hell. He is a free spirit who wants to feel the fullest sense of life, and for that, after his divorce, he bought a house near a nudist beach!
It wasn't long before he was approached by two absolutely gorgeous girls – a mum and her daughter – that he was lucky enough to become a part of his life!
After many years, her daughter grew up to be absolutely gorgeous, and something ignited in his heart that made him feel like never before.
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将扮演一个绝对令人难以置信的主角，拥有最精美的身体和肌肉线条。我只知道，每个女人看到他都会神魂颠倒！
他很幸运与一个令人窒息的女人离婚，这让他的生活变成了人间地狱。他是一个自由的人，想要感受最充实的生活，为此，他在离婚后在裸体海滩附近买了一套房子！
不久之后，两个绝对漂亮的女孩——一位妈妈和她的女儿——接近了他，他很幸运地成为了他生活的一部分！
时隔多年，女儿已长得绝色，他心中有一种从未有过的感觉被点燃。
